property_summary: For every caller X, invoking assertionDisputedCallback(assertionId) on the correct contract C never causes C to emit a PriceRequestAdded (i.e., requestPrice is not callable/triggered by arbitrary callers during assertionDisputedCallback), whereas the mutant that removed the onlyOptimisticAsserter guard on requestPrice can allow a non-optimisticAsserter caller to cause a PriceRequestAdded to be emitted for some assertionId and caller pairing.
change_summary: Remove the onlyOptimisticAsserter modifier so requestPrice can be called by any caller, changing whether PriceRequestAdded is emitted after calls by non-optimisticAsserter addresses.
